description: User-facing recipes default to the production-accepted A2UI universal-v1 descriptors in examples/a2ui. Presentation v1 files are adapter/diagnostic examples only. Replace placeholders, bind credentials in n8n, and prepare source data upstream; this package does not ingest external services.
updatePolicy: Every cross-family Update uses updateByKey=false to replace public card data and clear fields from the previous family.

patterns.stateFlow: Create on the error path; if recovery is confirmed, Update the same card with a complete success or cancelled A2UI descriptor.
patterns.callback: None by default. If adding an action, use only the constrained request action, enable Stream callbacks on Create, and validate/route the callback in n8n.
patterns.sensitivity: Exclude credentials, raw stack traces, request bodies, and private execution data. Prefer a restricted execution link displayed as text.

patterns.stateFlow: An existing monitor or schedule creates the alert when its own threshold fires; Update the same card when recovery is observed.
patterns.callback: None by default. A request-button acknowledgement requires callback Stream enabled at Create and deterministic actor/target validation.
patterns.sensitivity: Expose only approved resource labels and short summaries; omit sensitive hostnames, addresses, logs, and topology.

patterns.stateFlow: Create the current state; Update with a complete descriptor whenever workflow-owned state changes.
patterns.callback: None required; any request action is asynchronous and must route through deterministic workflow validation.
patterns.sensitivity: Keep status details concise; omit customer data, internal endpoints, and unredacted diagnostics.

patterns.stateFlow: Create once at task start; Update the same card with complete progress snapshots and a terminal state. n8n owns progress state and cadence.
patterns.callback: None required; the node does not persist task state or enforce transitions.
patterns.sensitivity: Do not expose job payloads, personal data, or secrets in progress text.

patterns.stateFlow: Create a new card for each period or Update the known current-period card with the complete descriptor; n8n owns that policy.
patterns.sensitivity: Aggregate and redact personal or confidential source data before building digest items.

patterns.stateFlow: Create one dated digest; Update only to intentionally revise that same report using the complete descriptor.
patterns.sensitivity: Remove unreleased details, private repository names, tokens, and internal incident data unless the audience is authorized.

patterns.sourceShape: GitHub-shaped values prepared upstream: title, summary, and concise text/key-value/list blocks.
patterns.stateFlow: Create per reporting window or Update a known report with a complete descriptor.
patterns.callback: None required; no GitHub API integration or ingestion is included.
patterns.sensitivity: Check repository visibility and redact private project or contributor information.

patterns.sourceShape: RSS-shaped values prepared upstream: selected entry title, short excerpt, and optional URL shown as text.
patterns.stateFlow: Create per reporting window or Update a known report with the complete replacement descriptor.
patterns.callback: None required; no feed polling or ingestion is included.
patterns.sensitivity: Treat feed content as untrusted text; do not render it as HTML or template code.

patterns.sourceShape: Changelog-shaped values prepared upstream: approved release label and concise change summary.
patterns.stateFlow: Create one card per release/reporting window; Update only to correct that report with the complete descriptor.
patterns.callback: None required; no changelog discovery or ingestion is included.
patterns.sensitivity: Publish only release information approved for the card audience.

patterns.stateFlow: Create a concise summary with a detail URL displayed as plain text; Update both from a complete descriptor when revising the report.
patterns.callback: The universal-v1 contract has no URL action. The detail URL is text, not a claimed clickable link; a separate request action requires Stream callbacks and verified routing.
patterns.sensitivity: Use an access-controlled HTTPS destination for restricted reports; DingTalk card visibility does not grant report access.

patterns.stateFlow: Create the report descriptor, then Update the same card with the complete status descriptor. updateByKey=false replaces report data so report-only content cannot remain.
patterns.sensitivity: The replacement status descriptor should contain only data appropriate for the card audience.
